name: Founder decision: Ratify a lead's window, the flag read with a lead as its subject, a lead's departure as a structure change with the pairing partner as interim holder, and that a held seat is never retired as a retirement
text_content:
P17, P18, P19, P20. A lead's window is opened by the stack on the leads' review record's counts (node overload across the thresholds after the carriers, "something new" above a count, the upward halves' mechanism read across the thresholds, the range breach count across the thresholds, the lead's plan not held after one extension) and never on a person's line about the lead, a founder's impression, or the co-lead's word; held by the lead's check-in holder in the window's form against the lead seat's sheet at its entry horizon with the center's fixes read first; closed by the same counts over the window in place of an assessor's form; ending as held, as not held with a move the lead chooses among the edge seats or an open lead seat by the succession rule, or as the package to the partners. A flag whose subject is a lead goes to the other lead and both founders the same day; the read is held by the other lead and the partner who does not pair with the subject; the lead hears it from their check-in holder with the second reader present; the line is written jointly in the closed form and reads to the pools, dimension 3, and the lead's naming range; the decision about staying is the partners' reserved class with counsel; a flag whose subject is a founder is Session 16's. A lead's departure is the three-pass read plus a structure change entry with the departure's line as reason, carried to the domain by the person page; the pairing partner holds the domain in the interim as a node-overload line on the partners' page with a closing condition, and the co-lead and a designation are refused as holders; the seat is filled from the pool by the nearest node through the lead seat's real-service practical with the written line for any outside hire; a departing lead owes field 15, a paid hand-back block against the records, the last weekly note, and the retirement of their working-with-me document, on the clock and nothing after. A seat whose holder is in it is never retired as a retirement and is a reduction with every open move offered first. Held on 86akhb2jg; extends 86akhcz7f, 86akhpvtf, 86akh7ref, and 17tn048qfn5 by reference. Before the leads are in the building. High.

Filed by Session 15 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjpw. Reasoning lives on the S15 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
